title: Shadow-Mode Evaluation of an AI Assistant for Multidisciplinary Tumor Boards
official: OnkoBot: Prospective Shadow-Mode Evaluation of a Locally Operated, Source-Grounded Large Language Model System for Drafting Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Recommendations
summary: This study tests whether an artificial intelligence (AI) system that drafts tumor board recommendations performs as well on new cases as it did on archived cases. The system runs in shadow mode at three multidisciplinary tumor boards of TUM University Hospital rechts der Isar. For each case it drafts a recommendation before the board meets. The board does not see the draft, and the draft has no influence on patient care. After the meeting, each draft is compared with the board decision. The agreement rate is then compared with the rate measured on archived decisions of the same boards.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Case registered for a session of a participating tumor board (hematology, orthopedics and sarcoma, head and neck) of TUM University Hospital rechts der Isar during the study period
* Board registration and pre-board patient documents available before the session starts

Exclusion Criteria:

* Case not discussed at the session, defined as no board report with a consensus decision for that date (deferred or withdrawn registrations)
* Session without a shadow run of the system

Excluded cases are counted and reported by reason.
